english.title: Fail to give name and address when requested to do so by an authorised person - Blackwall / Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been reasonably suspected by **(..SPECIFY NAME..) an authorised person of breaching or attempting to breach a byelaw, namely **(..SPECIFY BYELAW..) of the Blackwell and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018, failed to give your name and address when requested to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 9(1) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes: 9(2) The authorised person requesting details under byelaw 9(1) must state the nature of the suspected breach in general terms at the time of the request.
